request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I've made the change, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**What it does now:**
- **The check:** a sheet's tree is its ancestors plus its descendants and theirs. Adding a person, renaming one, adding an alias and the quick-add bar are now refused when the name is already used as a name or alias anywhere in that tree, just as a duplicate on the same sheet is.
- **People who already clash** are left as they are. Each row shows a new `person-clashing` field reading "yes". Any save through the person form is refused until the new name doesn't clash and none of their aliases clash. One consequence: there's no way to remove an alias, so someone whose *alias* clashes can't be edited through the form at all.

**Changes:**
- `PersonRepository`: two queries that collect the names and aliases used on a set of sheets.
- `PersonService`: a helper that gathers the names and aliases used across the tree, and the new checks in add, edit and alias.
- `PersonController` and `QuickAddController`: every returned person now carries `clashing`.
- `SheetState`: passes `clashing` through when it rebuilds people from a saved snapshot. Older snapshots don't have the field, so their people show "no".
- Front end: `clashing` added to the person type in `core/people.ts`, and the yes/no value shown on each row in `features/people/people.ts`.

**Choices to check:**
- **Paste box:** I left it alone. It only adds claims for people already on the sheet, so a name used only elsewhere in the tree is already refused. A clashing person who is on the sheet can still have claims pasted for them.
- **Bulk grade:** it saves through the same code path as the form, but I applied the clash check only to the person form. Bulk grading still changes the grade of people who clash.
- **Transfer and merge:** these don't check the tree. A transfer can still move someone into a tree where their name is used; they then show clashing "yes".
- **Import:** the app has no import feature, so that part of the request has nothing to apply to yet.
